name: Non-syndromic Sagittal Craniosynostosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Non-syndromic Sagittal Craniosynostosis

criteria.description: Premature fusion of the sagittal suture confirmed by imaging
No clinical or genetic evidence of syndromic craniosynostosis
Normal neurodevelopmental milestones in early infancy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of premature sagittal suture fusion with characteristic scaphocephalic head shape and absence of syndromic features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging; genetic testing may be used to exclude syndromic causes.

imaging: CT or MRI demonstrating premature fusion of sagittal suture
3D cranial reconstruction showing scaphocephalic skull shape
other: Clinical assessment confirming absence of syndromic features

distinguishingFeatures: Genetic mutations in FGFR or TWIST genes
Asymmetric skull shape due to external molding

redFlags: Signs of increased intracranial pressure (vomiting, irritability, bulging fontanelle)
references: Cohen MM Jr. Craniosynostosis: Diagnosis, Evaluation, and Management. 2000.
Kimonis VE, Gold JA, Hoffman TL, Panchal J, Boyadjiev SA. Genetics of craniosynostosis. Semin Pediatr Neurol. 2007.
